phase: After localization integration, before compact arguments, bounded phrase lookup, common-owner sorting and isolate-aware search
source_identity: Dirty working tree based on afd24252848a9ee6e02693fb5baf7d5ef8ca7541; exact pre-optimization source hashes were not captured.

scope.latency: Preloaded resources and warmed global romanization tables. Candidate search preparation excludes process transport, protocol receipt validation, resource loading and durable catalog storage. Admission uses 31 samples; queries use 32 warmups and 1001 samples. Individual nearest-rank percentiles exclude result destruction. Latency uses the uninstrumented allocator.
scope.heap: Separate executable with allocation counters. Requested Rust heap bytes only; excludes allocator overhead, shared resource sets, global romanization tables, native processes and WebView. Queries are warm. Residual bytes are measured after dropping the engine and catalog.
scope.comparison: Literal, English message-reference and bilingual message-reference fixtures share candidate identities and visible English text. Chinese/pinyin matches are absent from literal/English catalogs. This is not a pre-i18n baseline; retain i18n-before.json for the original literal search comparison.
